lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately three horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, with larger diameter blobs concentrated in the medial-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a structured grid across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp pixel intensity gradient from high luminance (dorsal) to low luminance (ventral shadow).

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high concentration of small, circular high-intensity spots distributed across its dorsal surface.
